name: itch
description: Install, log in to, and push game builds to itch.io with the butler CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Publish game builds to itch.io with butler.
interface.longDescription: A vendored, corrected copy of the itch-publish skill from gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills. Covers installing butler, authenticating with BUTLER_API_KEY or butler login, pushing builds to channels, versioning, and CI. See plugins/itch/skills/itch-publish/upstream-source.md for the source revision and what changed.
defaultPrompt: Push this build to my itch.io page with butler.
Set up butler to upload to itch.io from CI.
